Esther Rantzen Too Fragile for Assisted Suicide in Switzerland

Dame Esther Rantzen, a television presenter, has stated that she is too frail to travel to Dignitas, a Swiss assisted-suicide clinic, to end her life. Rantzen, known for her work on the show 'That's Life!', expressed that the journey would be too difficult for her at this time. She has previously spoken about her support for assisted dying for terminally ill individuals.
